explanation: This is almost always 0, and it is never above 0 at D1 or D2. It spikes to about 10 only at the GO step of a single trial early in the episode (roughly trials 8 to 36) when the previous trial was rewarded, usually just after a few mixed trials with rare transitions or missed rewards; later in the episode and during long steady streaks it stays at 0, with at most 1 to 2 at GO after a run of rewards.
